empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Import a skill from a file, a URL, or the community catalog.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.nameHint: Lowercase and hyphenated reads best in the prompt, e.g. pr-quality-rubric.
config.descriptionHint: This line is the skill’s interface — say WHEN an agent should apply it, in directive voice ("Flag…", "Require…"). It is what a reader scans in the list, and what you will read first when a review goes wrong.
config.typeHint: Grouping only — it does not change how the body is injected.
config.bodyHint: Markdown. Saving a changed body mints a new immutable version.
config.enabledHint: Off here means off for every agent — a global kill switch.
config.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? It will be unlinked from every agent.

stats.injectedHint: Runs whose assembled prompt actually contained this skill.
stats.avgTokensHint: Mean tokens this skill added per run. Current body: {body} tokens.
stats.attribution: Findings are produced by an agent, not by one skill — these numbers cover runs in which this skill was injected. Read them as correlation, not as proof the skill caused the finding.
stats.neverInjected: Never injected yet — link it to an agent and run a review.
stats.noFindings: No findings in the last 30 days.
stats.loadError: Could not load stats for this skill.

versions.title: Version history
versions.subtitle: Every body change snapshots the text, so a past run stays reproducible against the exact wording it used.
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore v{version}? This mints a new version with that body.

import.chooseHint: Markdown (.md, .markdown, .txt) or a .zip archive, up to 2 MB.
import.previewHint: Check what you are about to put into your agents’ prompts. Saving is the next step, and until you press it nothing reaches the database.
import.skippedHint: These archive entries were listed but never read or executed — a skill is text, nothing in it runs.
import.trustNotice: An imported skill is somebody else’s instructions landing in your agent’s prompt. Its body is stored and injected as delimiter-wrapped data, and it is saved disabled — read it before you enable it.
import.savedToast: Imported “{name}” — saved disabled until you vet it.
import.tooLarge: That file is larger than 2 MB.
